privacy.title: Privacy Policy and Data Protection
privacy.intro: At Loboczss, transparency is our foundation. This Privacy Policy details how we handle your personal data, in compliance with GDPR, LGPD, and global app store guidelines (Google Play Store and Apple App Store).
privacy.sec1_content: We collect information you provide directly (name, email, phone) and automatic technical data (IP address, device type, advertising identifiers). This data is essential for the safe and efficient operation of our applications.
privacy.sec2_content: Your data is used for: (a) Provision of services and technical support; (b) Marketing communications (only with your consent); (c) System security and fraud prevention; (d) Compliance with legal obligations.
privacy.sec3_content: We do not sell your data. We may share information with trusted partners (e.g., cloud providers, analysis tools like Google Analytics) only to enable app functionality, under strict confidentiality agreements.
privacy.sec4_content: We keep your data only as long as necessary. You have the right to request full deletion of your information at any time through our support channels.
privacy.sec5_content: You have the right to access, rectify, object, and port your data. We guarantee full control over your digital identity within our ecosystem.
privacy.sec6_content: Our services may integrate third-party APIs (Maps, Firebase, Ads). We recommend reading the privacy policies of these specific providers for a complete understanding.
privacy.contact_info: To exercise your rights or ask questions, contact our data protection officer: juan{'@'}loboczss.cloud
